name: Marañon Thrush
rangeDescription: Northern peru (upper marañón valley) and adjacent ecuador
description: Large, boldly marked thrush restricted to the Marañon Valley of northwestern Peru and southern Ecuador. It has brown upperparts and white underparts that are densely covered with thick, brown scales.

name: Cameroon Olive-Greenbul
rangeDescription: Montane forest of southeastern nigeria and southwestern cameroon; bioko
description: An active but easily overlooked long-tailed greenbul found in flocks in the understory and along the edges of montane forest. Can be found near ant swarms.

name: Gray-winged Francolin
rangeDescription: Grassland of lesotho and west-central south africa
description: Medium-sized, beautifully-patterned francolin. Shows small rufous patches in the wings in flight.

name: Golden-winged Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Western highlands of vietnam (mount ngoc linh)
description: Restricted to high-elevation forest (above 2,000 meters) in the Annamite Mountains of central Vietnam. Predominantly gray with gold and rusty patches in the wings and tail.

name: Annam Prinia
rangeDescription: Vietnam (langbian plateau)
description: A dull and poorly marked prinia with a strong bill and a long, graduated tail. Light brown above with faint dark streaking.

name: Short-tailed Parrot
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to eastern ecuador, eastern peru, and brazil north of the amazon
description: Medium-sized, uniformly bright green parrot with a short tail. Note the indistinct black eye-line, the dusky bill, and the darker green flight feathers; other parrots have more colorful plumage and longer tails.

name: Thamnornis
rangeDescription: Subdesert of southwestern madagascar
description: Odd, warbler-like, long-tailed and long-billed tetraka. Madagascar endemic that is the only tetraka regularly found in spiny forest.

name: Andaman Green-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Andaman and nicobar islands
description: A large, dull-green pigeon with a thick pale bill and a gray forehead. The dark olive-green and maroon wings have contrasting yellow lines below the shoulders, and the undertail is dull yellow with green patches.

name: Johannes's Tody-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to eastern peru, northern bolivia, and western amazonian brazil
description: Small, drab flycatcher. Olive brown with yellowish belly, diffuse throat streaking, and a light eye.

name: Trocaz Pigeon
rangeDescription: Laurel forest of madeira
description: Endemic to the island of Madeira, where it is largely restricted to native laurel and tree heath forests. Body is largely gray with a purple-pink breast, and a noticeable silvery patch with black streaks on the side of the neck.

name: Rusty-barred Owl
rangeDescription: Paraguay to southeastern brazil (minas gerais) and far northeastern argentina
description: Uniform buffy-brown owl with dark eyes. Mottled brown and white above and lightly barred on the breast.

name: Rondonia Bushbird
rangeDescription: South-central amazonian brazil, in rondônia, southern amazonas, and northern mato grosso
description: Large antbird with a very distinctive, robust upturned bill. Males are all black and females are chestnut with a black throat patch.

name: Venezuelan Sylph
rangeDescription: Mountains of northeastern venezuela (sucre and monagas)
description: Unmistakable, long-tailed hummingbird with straight, short bill. Male has very long, brilliant blue tail and iridescent blue throat; female very different, with shorter, white-tipped tail and whitish underparts.

name: Atlantic Petrel
rangeDescription: Tristan da cunha and gough islands; ranges south atlantic ocean
description: Powerful, stocky, two-toned petrel, all dark apart from the white breast and belly. Note the mostly dark wings, with a slightly paler ‘hand’ on the underwing.

name: Crimson-fronted Parakeet
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of southeastern nicaragua, costa rica, and western panama
description: Mostly green with long, pointed tail. Red forehead.

name: Choco Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Humid forest of northwestern colombia to northwestern ecuador
description: Small, rare woodpecker restricted to very wet lowland and foothill rainforest in western Colombia and far northwestern Ecuador. Both sexes have olive back and wings, extensive dark barring on underparts, and golden nape.

name: Spot-fronted Swift
rangeDescription: Mountains of costa rica; colombia to western ecuador and northern venezuela
description: Little-known swift found mostly in mountainous areas, though flocks occasionally venture into lowlands. All dark with short square tail and angular wings.

name: Japanese Thrush
rangeDescription: Central china and japan; winters to southern china and indochina
description: Elusive thrush, seldom seen far from cover. Favors well-shaded streamsides, gullies, and valleys in broadleaf hill forests during the breeding season, but can be found in sparser habitats in the non-breeding season.

name: White-bellied Minivet
rangeDescription: Peninsular india (punjab and rajasthan to bihar and mysore)
description: A beautiful minivet inhabiting open, dry scrub and savanna with scattered acacia (Prosopis) growth. The male has a glossy black upper body, face, and neck.

name: Palawan Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Palawan (southwestern philippines)
description: A fairly small owl of lowland forest. Dark brown above with a white bar behind the shoulder, and paler and warmer brown below with black marks.
